meetings.title: July 7, 2025 at 6:00 PM - School Board Listening Time
meetings.name: School Board Listening Time
meetings.notes:
School Board Listening Time Schedule Change
Beginning Monday, July 7, 2025, School Board Listening Time will be held before the first business meeting of each month.

This is a change in structure from previous Listening Times, previously held before the second business meeting of each month.

Listening Time provides an opportunity for the school district community to share comments, concerns, questions and ideas with representatives of the school board and the superintendent. For more information on School Board Listening Time, please visit rdale.org/discover/school-board.

Facilitating this Listening Time will be Helen Bassett, School Board Director - with Dr. Greta Evans-Becker, School Board Chair and Aviva Hillenbrand, School Board Treasurer.
meetings.location: Education Service Center Boardroom, 4148 Winnetka Ave N, New Hope, MN 55427

items.title: Welcome to Listening Time
items.description:
The Robbinsdale Area School Board welcomes and encourages input and feedback from members of our school district community. The School Board Listening Time is held from 6:00 - 6:50 p.m. before the first business meeting of each month (except when the calendar does not permit).

Facilitating this Listening Time will be Helen Bassett, School Board Director, with Dr. Greta Evans-Becker, School Board Chair and Aviva Hillenbrand, School Board Treasurer.

Questions? Send an email to Molly Olson, Executive Assistant to the School Board and Superintendent, at molly_olson@rdale.org

items.title: Action: Resolution Relating to Renewal of an Expiring Referendum
items.presenter:
Virginia Verbrugge, Assistant Director of Finance
Michael Hart, PMA Securities LLC
items.description:
Public comment regarding the operating referendum levy renewal will begin at 7:15 p.m. All people who wish to provide comment after the resolution is read will be allotted three minutes to speak publicly.

The voter-approved 2014 operating levy, which is set to expire next year, will generate approximately $24.8 million annually for Robbinsdale Area Schools to provide educational services to students. The state of Minnesota allows school districts to automatically renew previous operating referendums, which the Board of Education intends to do. The renewal of the operating levy is not a new tax, but a continuation of taxes already collected.

The Board will move to the vote after all public comments have been completed.
